def process(inner, at_flag):
    if not inner:
        return '', at_flag
    if len(inner) >= 3 and inner[:3] == "dot":
        rest, flag = process(inner[3:], at_flag)
        return '.' + rest, flag
    if len(inner) >= 2 and not at_flag and inner[:2] == "at":

        return '@' + rest, flag
    rest, flag = process(inner[1:], at_flag)
